IC2: Patient suffering from mild to moderate active proctitis [OR] or distal proctosigmoiditis (MAYO score ≥ 3 and ≤ 10) at inclusion based on clinical and endoscopic findings within 6 months before study inclusion.
IC3: Patient with evidence of endoscopic [AND] active proctitis [OR] or distal proctosigmoiditis  (Montreal classification E1 or E2 defined by an involvement not exceeding 25 cm from the anal margin) [AND] within 6 months before study inclusion.
IC4: Treatment [AND] of the current flare with Pentasa® to induce a remission initiated by the patient, the general practitioner or the gastroenterologist, during the inclusion visit [OR] or during the week before the inclusion visit.
IC5: Patient having received oral and written information on the study, without any objections for the use of his/her personal data, and having signed a written Informed Consent Form.
